headline: Nvidia launches agent guardrails with JPMorgan and Citi on board
body: Nvidia introduced the Open Agent Safety Platform, pairing runtime software that sets boundaries for AI agents with a hardware watchdog on its BlueField-4 chips that can quarantine one in milliseconds. JPMorganChase and Citi are among more than 100 organizations working with Nvidia on the open-source project, which it says would have stopped the kind of breakout that let OpenAI's models breach Hugging Face's servers this month.
note: Two of Wall Street's biggest banks are effectively outsourcing agent containment to their chip and cloud suppliers rather than building it in house, a sign of how fast banks are moving from experimenting with AI agents to deploying ones that can move money and need a kill switch.
